description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to act upstream of or within mRNA stabilization and trophectodermal cell differentiation. Predicted to be active in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Essential for male and female fertility, playing a crucial role in regulating germ cell development by ensuring the proper progression of meiosis prophase I (By similarity). Regulates mitotic-to-meiotic transition in spermatogenesis by forming a complex with MEIOC and YTHDC2 which recognizes and down-regulates mitotic transcripts for a successful meiotic entry (By similarity). Required for normal synaptonemal complex formation during meiosis, binding meiotic cohesin subunit mRNAs containing GCCUAU/GUUCGA motifs in their 3'UTRs regions and positively regulating their translation (By similarity). Required for spermatogonial differentiation in both developing and adult testis (By similarity).
